name: Humanize AI Text
description_en:
Humanize AI Text rewrites supplied text into alternative phrasing, with modes to shorten, expand, simplify or improve writing. It also describes frozen keywords and PDF/Word document handling. The practical task is editing a draft while protecting its facts and structure.

The site markets detector evasion, plagiarism-free output and search benefits. These are unverified vendor claims, not established properties of every rewrite. A revised sentence can still distort a number, citation, negation or obligation, so output needs comparison with the original before use.
description_zh:
Humanize AI Text 改写输入文本，提供缩短、扩展、简化和改善写作模式，另介绍关键词冻结及 PDF/Word 处理。实际任务是编辑初稿，同时保护事实和结构。

网站宣传规避检测、无抄袭和搜索收益，这些是未验证厂商主张，不是每次改写的既定属性。改写仍可能扭曲数字、引用、否定或义务，使用前需对照原文。

core_features.explanation_en: Select standard, shorten, expand, simplify or improve-writing modes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择标准、缩短、扩展、简化或改善模式。

core_features.explanation_en: Preserve selected terms and process supported documents, subject to output review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 保留所选术语并处理支持文档，仍需检查输出。

en: Compare a rewrite against factual limits, named terms and explicit exceptions.
zh: 把改写与事实限制、专名及明确例外逐项核对。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Use a short nonconfidential paragraph, choose a mode and frozen terms, then compare meaning and formatting before publication.
steps.zh: 选简短非机密段落、模式和冻结术语，发布前比较语义及格式。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Word-volume subscription with mode/file entitlements and billing-period conditions.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Grow advertises $18/month billed annually with 40,000 words/month. Scale shows $35/month and unlimited words; selected billing/renewal, fair use and file/input limits require confirmation. Page describes a three-day refund request; no refund or free-plan allowance verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Grow 宣传年付折合月 $18、月 40,000 词；Scale 展示月 $35、不限词，所选账期/续费、合理使用及文件/输入限制需确认。页面介绍三天退款申请，未验证退款或免费额度。

sources.title: Humanize AI: Guaranteed 100% Human Score & Unlimited Free Words
sources.research_notes_en: Rewriting modes, frozen keywords and file humanization; detector, plagiarism, meaning-preservation and search outcomes are vendor claims not tested.

sources.title: Plans & Pricing | Humanize AI Text
sources.research_notes_en: Grow/Scale displayed word capacities, annual qualifier on Grow and three-day refund request instructions; no assumed detection guarantee.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Test meaning preservation with a consequential sentence
sections.title_zh: 用关键句检验语义保留
sections.en: For an illustrative product note, rewrite a paragraph containing a feature name, a seven-day limit and an explicit not-supported condition. Freeze the required term and compare every amount, unit and exception afterwards. Expanding a sentence must not introduce unprovided evidence or promises. This is an editorial evaluation exercise; no rewrite or file-format test was performed.
sections.zh: 例如产品说明可选含功能名、七日期限及明确不支持条件的段落，冻结必需术语，改写后逐项核对金额、单位和例外。扩写不能加入未提供的证据或承诺。这是编辑评估建议，本文未实际改写或测试文件格式。

sections.title_en: A detector score is not proof of authorship or originality
sections.title_zh: 检测分数不能证明作者身份或原创性
sections.en: The site promotes undetectability and plagiarism-free output. This research did not run detectors or compare outputs with source corpora, and cannot guarantee either claim. Similar wording, altered citations and unsupported additions remain review questions. File-layout preservation is also advertised rather than independently verified; inspect tables, footnotes and references in the exported document.
sections.zh: 网站宣传不可检测和无抄袭，本文未运行检测或对照语料，不能保证。近似措辞、引用变化及无依据补充仍需审查，文件布局保留也只是宣传，应核对导出的表格、脚注和参考资料。

sections.title_en: Read the word limit and billing qualifier together
sections.title_zh: 同时核对字数与账期限定
sections.en: Grow displays $18/month billed annually with 40,000 words/month. Scale displays $35/month and unlimited words, but the extracted view does not unambiguously bind every Scale amount to the billing selector. Confirm renewal total, per-input/file limits and fair use. The pricing page describes a refund request within three days by email; no refund was attempted and eligibility should be checked against current policy.
sections.zh: Grow 展示年付折合每月 $18、月 40,000 词。Scale 显示月 $35 和不限词，但抽取视图未明确把所有金额绑定账期，应确认续费总额、单次/文件限制及合理使用。价格页说明三天内邮件申请退款，本文未实际申请，资格需核现行政策。

sections.title_en: Use it as an editing candidate with human review
sections.title_zh: 把它作为需要人工审核的编辑候选
sections.en: It may suit exploring alternative phrasing for a draft whose facts are already known. It should not be relied on to validate a research paper, establish originality, certify compliance or guarantee search rankings. Confirm data handling before uploading confidential files. No source license, self-hosted package, language quality, detector outcome or live account was verified.
sections.zh: 可用于对事实已知的初稿探索其他措辞，不应依赖它验证论文、证明原创、认证合规或保证排名。机密文件上传前应确认数据处理。本次未核实源码许可、自托管、语言质量、检测结果或真实账户。

research_gaps: No rewrite, document upload, plagiarism/detector check, SEO/GEO result or refund was tested.
Billing selection/currency, fair use, file/input limits, privacy/retention, license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
